about: Contract v1: one postings.url per platform, in the exact shape that platform's adapter stores, with the board slug that produced it.

Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and iCIMS store the URL the board itself returns (absolute_url, hostedUrl, jobUrl, the sitemap's <loc>). Workday, Eightfold and Taleo store a URL the adapter builds from the board slug and the job's id.

It exists because the bot's posting_details matches postings.url with regexes, and those must keep matching what the adapters store. DIAYN's tests/test_contract.py runs every adapter on a canned response and requires these URLs exactly.
Workday boards on the other host shape, slug 'wdN/tenant/Site@site', store https://wdN.myworkdaysite.com/recruiting/tenant/Site/job/..., which posting_details has never matched.
